text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Don Young reiterated coverage of Compaq Computer Corp with a buy rating, saying he found the company's top executives very bullish at a meeting with them on Monday.

-- "The 'Rolling Thunder' series of product announcements is invigorating demand. We believe there is little question that the troubled notebook sector has experienced a strong turnaround," Young said in a research note.
-- He said management was very confident in its ability to hold gross margins at 23 percent "and we believe there is upside to our gross margin forecast."
-- Young said that Compaq management is developing a new logistics model to raise asset turnover and that a third quarter earnings surprise was possible.

-- "We think the near-term and long-term outlook is very bullish for the company," he said. "Not only do we see the PC market improving, we also believe Compaq is strengthening its competitive position."
-- Shares were up 3-3/8 at 64-3/4 in active trading.
